solution:
Let $u=\sin x$, so $du=\cos x\,dx$ and $\cos^2x=1-u^2$. Then
$$\int_0^{\pi/2}\sin^2x\cos^3x\,dx=\int_0^1u^2(1-u^2)\,du=\left[\frac{u^3}{3}-\frac{u^5}{5}\right]_0^1=\frac{2}{15}.$$
